title: TAKE CONTROL: HOW TO SECURE YOUR DISCORD ACCOUNT FOR BRAINLYHQ
excerpt: While our moderation team works hard to keep BrainlyHQ a secure place for everyone, your personal account security is your first line of defense. Learn how to optimize your Discord privacy settings, enable two-factor authentication, and protect your data while being an active part of our community.
body:
## **Your Account, Your Rules**

At BrainlyHQ, we provide the tools and official support channels to keep our community safe. However, the best security system starts right in your own Discord settings.

Taking a few minutes to adjust your privacy preferences can prevent unauthorized access, block unwanted messages, and ensure your study sessions remain uninterrupted. Here is a quick guide to setting up your account for maximum security.

## **Enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)**

If you only do one thing after reading this post, make it this. Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra layer of security to your account. Even if someone manages to guess your password, they won't be able to log in without the unique code generated by your mobile device.

To turn it on:

1. Go to your Discord **User Settings** (the gear icon).
2. Navigate to the **My Account** tab.
3. Click the **Enable Two-Factor Auth** button and follow the on-screen instructions.

## **Manage Your Direct Message Privacy**

As we mentioned in our previous guide, BrainlyHQ moderators will never DM you first. To further protect yourself from spam or malicious messages from bad actors pretending to be staff, you can control who is allowed to send you direct messages.

- **Server Default Privacy:** You can disable direct messages from server members entirely. Just right-click on the BrainlyHQ server icon, select **Privacy Settings**, and toggle off _Direct Messages_.
- **Safe Direct Messaging:** In your main **User Settings > Privacy & Safety**, make sure your explicit image filter is set to _Keep me safe_. This automatically scans and blocks direct messages containing explicit content.

## **Be Smart About Third-Party Apps and Links**

Discord is full of fun bots and integrations, but you should always be cautious about what you click or authorize.

- **Never authorize unknown applications** to access your Discord account. Malicious apps can join servers for you or spam your friends list.
- **Double-check URLs** before clicking. If a user sends a link offering "free Nitro," "Brainly admin access," or special study cheats, it is almost certainly a phishing attempt trying to steal your login credentials.

> **Reminder:** Official BrainlyHQ services and resources will always be shared through our official server announcements or verified `brainly.com` domains.

## **Report Suspicious Activity**

Your vigilance helps keep the entire BrainlyHQ community safe. If you notice an account sending suspicious links in chat, trying to bypass our privacy rules, or acting strangely, don't engage with them.

Instead, use our **Help Form** or the official **ticket system** to report the user. Our moderation team will handle the rest!

**Stay secure, stay curious, and happy studying!**
